description: Built 3 March 1977; delivered 15 March 1977; registered 20 April 1977 as CCCP-88256 to the Armenian Civil Aviation Directorate 2nd Yerevan detachment at Zvartnots; to Armenian Airlines and re-registered EK-88256 in 1993; withdrawn before 1997 and stored at Zvartnots; erected as a monument at Ashtarak after 2003 where it remains
